articles.summary: DUBUQUE, Iowa --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Feb. 2, 2026-- Flexsteel Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLXS) (“Flexsteel” or the “Company”), one of the largest manufacturers, importers, and marketers of residential furniture products in the United States, today reported second quarter fiscal 2026 results.
articles.title: Flexsteel Industries, Inc. Reports Strong Fiscal Second Quarter 2026 Results
